symbols.name: fixed bilinear space
symbols.meaning: The fixed bilinear space on which all subspace labels are based.
symbols.quote: Subspace labels are based on the fixed bilinear space $F$, whose [bilinear form](bilinear-form.md) $\langle x,y\rangle$ is linear in each argument, where $x$ and $y$ are vectors of $F$.

symbols.name: first argument
symbols.meaning: A vector of F, the first argument of the bilinear form.
symbols.quote: Subspace labels are based on the fixed bilinear space $F$, whose [bilinear form](bilinear-form.md) $\langle x,y\rangle$ is linear in each argument, where $x$ and $y$ are vectors of $F$.

symbols.name: second argument
symbols.meaning: A vector of F, the second argument of the bilinear form.
symbols.quote: Subspace labels are based on the fixed bilinear space $F$, whose [bilinear form](bilinear-form.md) $\langle x,y\rangle$ is linear in each argument, where $x$ and $y$ are vectors of $F$.

symbols.name: label
symbols.meaning: A nondegenerate subspace of F, the label attached to a wire.
symbols.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $F$, meaning $U\cap U^{\perp}=\{0\}$, where $U^{\perp}$ is the set of vectors orthogonal to every vector of $U$.

symbols.name: orthogonal complement
symbols.meaning: The set of vectors of F orthogonal to every vector of U.
symbols.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $F$, meaning $U\cap U^{\perp}=\{0\}$, where $U^{\perp}$ is the set of vectors orthogonal to every vector of $U$.

symbols.name: larger label
symbols.meaning: The larger of the two labels on an edge, containing the smaller label U.
symbols.quote: On every edge one label contains the other. For an edge with $U \subseteq V$, the labels $U$ and $V$ are its smaller and larger label.

symbols.name: orthogonal residual
symbols.meaning: The orthogonal residual of an edge, the orthogonal complement of the smaller label inside the larger one.
symbols.quote: Its orthogonal residual is $R = V\cap U^{\perp}$, the orthogonal complement of the smaller label inside the larger one.
